Waggin’ Wednesday: Meet Hey Jo!

September 2, 2026

Meet Hey Jo! Hey Jo came to us from Mississippi and he is quite the southern lover boy! He loves to run around the yard with his stuffies and squeaky toys but will always stop in for a kiss and snuggle between playing because he LOVES his people. A little secret about Hey Jo…he has the biggest and whitest smile ever!! Don’t let this one get away, he is awesome! Come meet Hey Jo during our open adoption hours at the Animal Rescue League of Boston’s Cape Cod Animal Care & Adoption Center (3981 Main St, Brewster) or call to learn more. The Brewster location can be reached at 617-426-9170 ext 305. ARL is open by appointment only on Mondays and Tuesdays, and open to the general public Wednesday-Sunday from 1-6 p.m. Click here for more information.
